links.outcome: Certified medical interpreter review of translation transcripts for errors
links.effect: Human-certified interpreter reviewed 10 transcripts (3597 words) and identified 23 errors (99.4% raw accuracy); 3 had potential clinical consequences but were minor ambiguities.
links.quote: There were 23 errors (raw accuracy rate of 99.4%).

unlisted_practices: Using a generative AI model as a real-time medical interpreter for English-Spanish translation

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT-4 translation accuracy in a simulated provider-patient interaction, but does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice comparative condition.
